name: Osmious-Threnody
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait towering mountain ranges, and everything the light never reaches.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Nothing about the gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
For traders, biomass alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
